vibevoice.outputVerbatim: VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming is a unified streaming ASR model that transcribes Who (Speaker) said What (Content), with support for Customized Hotwords and 10 languages.
vibevoice.speakerHints: DOCUMENTED: who-said-what speaker attribution is a first-class card feature (cluster labels, not identities)
vibevoice.hotwords: DOCUMENTED: 'Users can provide customized hotwords, such as names and technical terms'

streamingChunking.derived: 3200 samples/token @ 24 kHz = 0.1333 s/token -> chunk ~= 22 tokens (~2.93 s), lookahead ~4 tokens (~0.53 s)
streamingChunking.semantics: hypothesis-per-chunk while speech arrives; FINAL transcript once the chunk leaves the lookahead window (the WER object)

vibevoice.architecture: VibeVoiceForASRStreamingTraining: qwen2-family 28-layer decoder (hidden 1536, vocab 151936, tied embeddings) + acoustic/semantic tokenizers + diffusion head (the full VibeVoice architecture family)
vibevoice.confidence: NOT DOCUMENTED in the card — asrConfidence stays undefined (architecture-lock §4: never invented)
vibevoice.timestamps: chunk-level timing only (the chunking convention above); NO word-level timestamps documented

qwen3asr.output: per-utterance {language, text}; word/character timestamps ONLY via the SEPARATE Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B model
qwen3asr.speakerHints: NOT DOCUMENTED: zero card hits for speaker/diarization — the HF009 pyannote composition is REQUIRED for speaker metadata
qwen3asr.hotwords: NOT DOCUMENTED: no hotword support in the card — a typed capability gap for the multilingual candidate

languages.cardDecomposition: 30 languages + 22 Chinese dialects (the card's own table)

qwen3asr.streaming: streaming / offline unified inference; streaming ONLY via the vLLM backend ('streaming inference is only available with the vLLM backend'), and streaming mode does not support batch inference or timestamps
qwen3asr.generationConfig: do_sample=false, temperature=1e-6 — the near-greedy determinism anchor
qwen3asr.preprocessor: 30 s chunks, 16 kHz input, 128-mel Whisper-style features (preprocessor_config.json)
qwen3asr.sibling: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B (the card names it: 'the 0.6B version achieves accuracy-efficient trade-off') — recorded as an HF015-lane observation; NOT substituted for the pinned 1.7B candidate
qwen3asr.confidence: NOT DOCUMENTED in the card — asrConfidence stays undefined (never invented)
